Wedding antipasto.d: Salami, aged provolone, olives and roasted peppers, at room temperature.
Wedding antipasto.note: Laid out like a Long Beach wedding table.

Golden arancini.d: Crisp risotto balls, fried golden round a melting mozzarella heart.
Golden arancini.note: Fried golden, two to an order.

Clemenza's Sunday sauce.d: Pork and beef meatballs, fennel sausage, slow tomato, pecorino.
Clemenza's Sunday sauce.note: A splash of wine, a pinch of sugar. Clemenza's trick.

Ricotta & pistachio cannoli.d: Crisp shells, orange-scented ricotta, dark chocolate, crushed pistachio.
Ricotta & pistachio cannoli.note: Take the cannoli. Boxed and tied with string.
